layer.name: button_container
layer.css: display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; align-items:center; border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden; background-color:rgba(169,159,151,0.6); box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); padding:4px; gap:4px;

layer.name: btn_tien_ich
layer.css: text-align:center; color:#fff; font-family:UTM Optima; font-size:10px; font-weight:500; border-radius:12px;
layer.onhover: if(!layer[btn_tien_ich].is_active, set(layer[btn_tien_ich].css, 'text-align:center; color:#EACDA6; font-family:UTM Optima; font-size:10px; font-weight:500;'));
layer.onout: if(!layer[btn_tien_ich].is_active, set(layer[btn_tien_ich].css, 'text-align:center; color:#fff; font-family:UTM Optima; font-size:10px; font-weight:500;'));
